task: OPEN-024 (NCG workbook) / the ARBS-retirement investigation's identified gap: build the 'semantic functor' between Track A (finite relational seed R, this session's runs 13-16) and Track B (finite NCG spectral triple, the newly-found workbook).
construction: See reconstruction/toe_rebuild/compiler/ncg_bridge.py for the full, real, executed code. Three phases: (1) bare graded module (H_F=C^N, gamma_F from R's own TH-ARBS-001A bipartition, D_F from R's own already-derived canonical orientation N_orient, run 15); (2) real structure via the standard particle+antiparticle doubling J_F[v,w]=[conj(w),conj(v)] (the generic, always-available way to add a real structure, taken directly from the NCG workbook's own sheet 171_V2_CALC_018_RIGHT_REP_J, not invented here); (3) order-zero/first-order tests against a generic (non-Standard-Model-specific) maximal abelian algebra, mirroring the exact kind of minimal candidate the NCG workbook's own '2-point test model' uses for its own closed baseline result.
target_independence: No Standard-Model representation content (quark/lepton labels, hypercharges, 3 generations, dim=32) was used anywhere in this construction -- verified by inspection of ncg_bridge.py, which references only R's own combinatorial data (bipartition, canonical orientation) and a generic diagonal algebra.

results_exhaustive_over_all_259_candidat.phase1_structural_axioms: 100% PASS (259/259): gamma_F^2=1, {D_F,gamma_F}=0, D_F Hermitian, D_F off-diagonal in the grading basis -- all hold for every candidate at every N.
results_exhaustive_over_all_259_candidat.phase2_KO_dimension: 100% consistent (259/259 at every N): the same-sign doubling convention always lands in KO-dimension 0 mod 8 (eps=+1,eps'=+1,eps''=+1); the opposite-sign convention always lands in KO-dimension 6 mod 8 (eps=+1,eps'=+1,eps''=-1). No other KO class (of the 8 possible, per the NCG workbook's own sign table) is ever realized by either convention.

results_exhaustive_over_all_259_candidat.phase3_first_order: 100% FAIL (0/259, both sign conventions): the generic maximal abelian algebra never satisfies first-order, for any seed, at any N.

these_results_are_PROVEN_general_theorem.method: The 100% consistency (no partial/mixed results anywhere) suggested these might be facts about the CONSTRUCTION METHOD itself rather than about which specific seed is chosen -- verified by hand-derivation, then confirmed computationally.
these_results_are_PROVEN_general_theorem.THM-BRIDGE-ORDER-ZERO-001: PROVEN. Because the diagonal algebra is represented IDENTICALLY on both the particle and antiparticle copies, J pi(b) J^-1 = pi(b) EXACTLY for every generator b (verified: J0 @ pi(b) @ J0^-1 == pi(b) to machine precision) -- so order-zero reduces to [pi(a),pi(b)]=0, which holds trivially since diagonal matrices always commute. This holds for ANY starting seed R and ANY N -- it is a fact about using an identical (non-chiral) representation on both copies, not a discriminating property of which graph was chosen.
these_results_are_PROVEN_general_theorem.THM-BRIDGE-FIRST-ORDER-OBSTRUCTION-001: PROVEN. Given J pi(b) J^-1 = pi(b) (above), first-order reduces to [[D_F,pi(a)],pi(b)]=0 for all diagonal a,b. For a diagonal matrix pi(a), [D_F,pi(a)]_{ij} = D_F_{ij}(a_j-a_i) -- zero on the diagonal, but nonzero at any off-diagonal entry (i,j) where D_F_{ij}!=0 AND a_i!=a_j. Since a ranges over all one-hot generators, some choice always has a_i!=a_j at any edge -- so [D_F,pi(a)] is diagonal (hence commutes with every pi(b)) IF AND ONLY IF D_F=0 identically. Verified directly: a control run with D_F artificially set to zero makes first-order hold trivially; every genuine (non-degenerate) seed in F_N^derived_v2 has D_F!=0 by construction (Gamma-fixed relations with N>=2 always have edges), so first-order NEVER holds for this algebra/doubling combination, for ANY nonempty seed, at ANY N -- again a fact about the construction, not about which specific graph was tried.

honest_interpretation.what_this_establishes: A genuine, principled, non-arbitrary semantic-functor CANDIDATE was built and tested -- not asserted, not assumed to work. Its structural (grading/reality) axioms are satisfied and land in specific, well-defined KO-dimension classes (0 or 6, depending on convention) -- a real, if modest, connection between Track A's combinatorics and Track B's formalism.
honest_interpretation.what_this_does_NOT_establish: The algebra-representation axioms (order-zero/first-order) do not yet discriminate between different admissible seeds, because BOTH results (universal order-zero pass, universal first-order fail) are consequences of the SPECIFIC doubling choice (identical representation on both P/A copies) and the SPECIFIC algebra choice (maximal abelian), not of the seed's own structure. The bridge as built is too coarse a probe to show whether the graph's specific topology matters to NCG-compatibility at all.
honest_interpretation.why_the_obstruction_is_structurally_expe: This mirrors, rather than contradicts, how the actual physical NCG Standard Model construction works: the real construction requires the particle and antiparticle (or more precisely left/right chirality) representations to be REPRESENTATION-THEORETICALLY DIFFERENT (not identical copies of each other), and requires D_F's nonzero entries (the Yukawa structure) to be compatible with that asymmetric bimodule structure specifically -- exactly what the NCG workbook's own OZ-001 ('H_F components are A_F-A_F^op BIMODULES', not a single trivial representation) and DF-003 ('Yukawa block... gauge-compatible target structure') require, and exactly what this run's simplified bridge did not yet attempt to build.
honest_interpretation.next_dependency: Build a bridge variant with genuinely ASYMMETRIC left/right (or particle/antiparticle) representations of a non-abelian candidate algebra -- e.g. representing the diagonal algebra differently on the two copies (contragredient/conjugate representation) rather than identically -- and re-test order-zero/first-order. This is the natural, well-motivated next step (not a new axiom; it directly follows the NCG workbook's own bimodule requirement, OZ-001), not yet attempted this run given the scope already covered.
